scope: Avoid silent training coverage reduction without confusing legitimate optimizer-in-backward grouping
findings: Current parameter policy compares total registered nn.Module parameters, which are unchanged by disabling gradients or removing parameters from optimizer groups.
R14 real optimizer captures show 34-to-2 catalog entries and 1075970304-to-2097408 trainable/updated elements at every one of 20 logical updates; existing loss gate already rejected the candidate.
Existing optimizer summary can expose this measured narrowing, but it is cooperative evidence rather than authentication or bitwise parameter-state equivalence.
minimum_proposed_design: Add an independent host-derived training-coverage comparison observation for baseline/original-workload reference and candidate, with explicit status comparable/changed/unknown and raw supporting totals; leave current acceptance unchanged until separately approved.

Only use validated source/run-bound captures with complete logical boundaries and update sets. For completed original baseline use its 20 actual logical records; for original OOM use only a completed original-workload-bound reference. Zero-step OOM initial constructor metadata is not proof of baseline update coverage.

Compare counts/numel of actually catalogued requires-grad parameters and per-logical-update union coverage, never optimizer object counts or raw post-hook call counts. Legitimate 34 child AdamW optimizers grouped into one backward remain 20 logical updates over 34 unique parameter identities.

When strict no-model-change policy and complete comparable captures demonstrate reduced trainable/update coverage, surface a specific semantic-policy violation with measured before/after fields before accepting the repair. Do not infer equivalence merely from equal coverage or use this observation to relax existing loss/input/reference gates.

Prefer planner/preflight feedback for an explicit freeze/filter plan contradicting a fully trainable executed baseline, allowing another plan within the existing six rounds; do not rewrite the model plan or auto-clear flags.
limitations: Local p00001-style IDs identify process-local Parameter lifetimes; they cannot be compared across runs as stable layer identities.
Current requires_grad_at_observation is captured only on first optimizer/graph observation; it does not record later flag transitions or the entire model.
An absent optimizer parameter is not by itself proof that it is frozen. Report optimizer coverage reduction, not invented global frozen counts.
Equal aggregate counts/numel cannot detect replacing one same-sized subset by another; exact cross-run sets would require a separately designed stable parameter identity/name binding.

Version-counter advancement is an update observation, not proof that numerical values changed. A generic exact optimizer that skips numerically unchanged updates can alter version patterns; do not make unsupported broad equivalence claims.
Constructor registration newly improves zero-step initial evidence but does not certify successful subclass construction or future updates.
No numerical tolerance, fixed-nine denominator, six-target threshold, historical outcome or required acceptance check was edited.
